subject: dsa
title: Koko Eating Bananas
summary: Binary-search the answer, not the input. Feasibility is monotonic in speed, so search speeds 1..max; for each, check if the total hours fit, and narrow toward the slowest that works.
problem: Koko eats one pile per hour at speed k, taking ceil(pile/k) hours per pile. Find the smallest k that finishes all piles within h hours.

steps.caption: Koko eats one pile at speed k bananas/hour, taking ceil(pile/k) hours each. Find the slowest k that clears piles [3,6,7,8] within h = 7 hours.
A higher speed never needs more hours, so feasibility is monotonic. Binary-search the speed over [1, 8] (8 = the largest pile).
Test mid = 4: hours = 1+2+2+2 = 7 <= 7. Feasible: 4 works, but maybe a slower speed does too.
Since 4 works, keep it as a candidate and search the slower half, [1..4].
Test mid = 2: hours = 2+3+4+4 = 13 > 7. Too slow: 2 and anything slower can't finish in time.
Test mid = 3: hours = 1+2+3+3 = 9 > 7. Too slow, so drop it.
Only speed 4 remains and it works, so the minimum eating speed is 4 bananas/hour.
